text: Sorry if this is nothing, I keep going back and forth about whether to even message. My daughter Isla is 11. She's had a cold since yesterday, runny nose, sneezing loads, all the usual stuff. Tonight she felt hot so I took her temperature and it was 39. The weird thing is that even though it's 39 her hands and feet are freezing, like properly cold, and she's shivering away under two blankets. Then when I was helping her into her pyjamas I noticed some little dark reddy purple dots on her tummy and a couple on her arm. I remembered reading about the glass thing so I pressed a glass on them and they're still there, they don't fade at all. I don't know if I'm overthinking it because she's otherwise just got a cold. Her colour looks normal to me, her face and lips are their usual colour, not pale or anything. And she hasn't had any fits or funny shaking episodes, just the shivering from being cold. Is this something I should be worried about or am I being paranoid?
